# Swing Trade Systems

> A comprehensive guide to building complete swing trading systems with strategies, planning, backtesting, and live trading execution.

Swing Trade Systems provides educational resources and practical frameworks for traders implementing swing trading strategies on major exchanges like NYSE and NASDAQ. The site covers the five core components of successful swing trading: plans, strategies, resources, backtesting/paper trading, and live trading execution.

## Key Topics

- Swing Trading Systems
- Swing Trading Strategies
- Technical Analysis
- Trading Plans
- Backtesting
- Paper Trading
- Live Trading
- Entry Conditions
- Support/Resistance
- Trend Lines
- Moving Averages
- S&P 500
- NYSE/NASDAQ
- Trading Education
- Strategy Guide

- [Swing Trading Strategies overview](https://www.swingtradesystems.com/trading-strategies-main-page.html): Overview of trading strategies, a core component of swing trading systems
- [Swing Trading Resources overview](https://www.swingtradesystems.com/trading-resources-main-page.html): Overview of trading resources, a component of complete swing systems
- [Backtesting/Paper Trading overview](https://www.swingtradesystems.com/backtesting-paper-trading-main-page.html): Overview of backtesting and paper trading components of swing systems
- [Live Swing Trading overview](https://www.swingtradesystems.com/live-trading-main-page.html): Overview of live trading component in complete swing trading systems

## Trading Plans & Strategy Documentation

- [Swing Trading Plan Template](https://www.swingtradesystems.com/trading-plans-example.html): Trading plan template with 30 questions and model answers for planning
- [Swing Trading Strategies example](https://www.swingtradesystems.com/trading-strategies-example.html): Example swing strategy using S&P 500 with moving averages and patterns
- [Swing Trading Strategies](https://www.swingtradesystems.com/swing-trading-strategies.html): Guide to winning swing trading strategies including support/resistance
- [10 Laws of Technical Trading](https://www.swingtradesystems.com/ten-laws-technical-trading.html): John Murphy's ten laws of technical trading for swing traders

## Backtesting, Paper Trading & Live Trading

- [Paper Trading documentation](https://www.swingtradesystems.com/paper-trading-documentation.html): Documented paper trading records using Strategy 1-2-3 with performance analysis
- [Live Swing Trading walk-through](https://www.swingtradesystems.com/live-trading-walk-through.html): Daily routine walkthrough for swing traders with entry and position management

## Technical Analysis & Trading Education

- [How to Draw Trend Lines](https://www.swingtradesystems.com/how-to-draw-trend-lines.html): Guide to drawing trend lines for improved technical analysis and profitability
- [Swing Trading Resources guide](https://www.swingtradesystems.com/trading-resources-guide.html): Guide to free online trading resources including brokers and platforms
- [Free Trading eBooks #1](https://www.swingtradesystems.com/trading-ebooks.html): Collection of free trading eBooks on candlesticks and trading signals

## Market Reference & Tools

- [2026 Trading Days Calendar](https://www.swingtradesystems.com/trading-days-calendars.html): NYSE/NASDAQ trading calendar with holidays and market hours for 2026
- [World Stock Exchanges](https://www.swingtradesystems.com/world-stock-exchanges.html): Directory of world stock exchanges with hours and market capitalization
- [Stock Market Calculators](https://www.swingtradesystems.com/stock-mkt-data.html): Calculators for trading days and market hours for NYSE and NASDAQ
- [Trading Days and Hours Countdown](https://www.swingtradesystems.com/trading-days-hours-left.html): Countdown tracker for trading days and hours remaining in current period
